title: Normal competence uses zero skills when none materially help
invariant: Installed skills are optional context costs and are not loaded merely because they are available.
given: The PM has a bounded task to rename a private helper and update its existing unit test. The repository contains optional Kubernetes, Terraform, security, methodology-planning, and methodology-retrospective skills, but none contributes material knowledge to this local edit.
when: The PM selects skills for the Implementer Task Packet.

must: use normal role competence and repository context
avoid skill ceremony when no skill materially improves the task
must_not: preload installed skills just in case
select a skill merely because its technology exists elsewhere in the repository
